claim: The tactic-route runner honored an explicit four-worker configuration, launched four persistent native workers concurrently, evaluated one deterministic seed on each worker concurrently, and restored report order independently of completion order.

determinism.partition: Seed index i is assigned to worker i modulo worker count.
determinism.aggregation: Worker results are indexed and sorted by original seed index before report construction.
determinism.source_validation: Every worker must produce the identical initial FactSnapshot and root checkpoint digest before evaluation begins.

timing_scope: Campaign wall time begins before configuration and execution-binding validation and includes repository artifact hashing, worker launch, initial native probes, seed evaluation, per-seed persistence, and worker shutdown through report aggregation. Final report encoding and write occur after the recorded boundary.
interpretation: The four attempt roots were created within 1.001 milliseconds; their initial probes completed within 171.671 milliseconds of one another; and all seed result writes completed within 270.139 milliseconds. This establishes real concurrent worker use. It is not the 1/2/4/8 scaling benchmark and makes no scaling-efficiency claim.
